verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਿ ਧਨੁਖ ਚਲਾਈਅਤ ਬਾਨ ਤਾਨਿ  ਚਲਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhar dhanukh chalaieeat baan taan  chalio jai tit hee kau jit hee chalaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as an arrow is placed in a bow, the bowstring is pulled and arrow released in the direction in which it is intended to go.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਲਗਾਏ ਤਨ ਤੇਜ ਕਰਿ  ਦੌਰਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਆਤੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਦਉਰਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise asavai chaabuk lagaae tan tej kar  dhauario jai aatur hui jit hee dhauraieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a horse is whipped to make it run faster and agitated, it keeps running in the direction it is made to run

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਠਾਂਢੀ ਰਹੈ  ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਪਠਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhaasee naikaa kai agrabhaag Thaa(n)ddee rahai  dhaavai tit hee taeh jit hee paThaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as an obedient maid-servant keeps standing in attention in front of her mistress, and she hastes away to the direction she is sent,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਭੂਮ  ਜਤ ਜਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ॥੬੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise praanee kirat sa(n)jog lag bhramai bhoom  jat jat khaan paan tahee jai khaieeaai ||610||

en.bdb: Similarly, an individual keeps wandering on this Earth according to the deeds that he had performed (in previous birth). He goes where he is destined to sustain himself.  (610)
